import heapq

class NetworkFlow:
    def __init__(self, nodes):
        self.V = nodes
        self.edges_descriptor = []
        self.adj_list = [[] for _ in range(nodes)]

    def link(self, u, v, capacity, cost):
        idx = len(self.edges_descriptor)
        self.edges_descriptor.append((u, len(self.adj_list[u])))
        self.adj_list[u].append(self._Link(v, len(self.adj_list[v]), capacity, cost))
        self.adj_list[v].append(self._Link(u, len(self.adj_list[u]) - 1, 0, -cost))
        return idx

    class Connection:
        def __init__(self, start, end, capacity, flow, cost):
            self.start = start
            self.end = end
            self.capacity = capacity
            self.flow = flow
            self.cost = cost

    def fetch(self, i):
        u, pos = self.edges_descriptor[i]
        fwd = self.adj_list[u][pos]
        bwd = self.adj_list[fwd.to][fwd.rev]
        return self.Connection(u, fwd.to, fwd.cap + bwd.cap, bwd.cap, fwd.cost)

    def enumerate(self):
        out = []
        for i in range(len(self.edges_descriptor)):
            u, pos = self.edges_descriptor[i]
            fwd = self.adj_list[u][pos]
            bwd = self.adj_list[fwd.to][fwd.rev]
            out.append(self.Connection(u, fwd.to, fwd.cap + bwd.cap, bwd.cap, fwd.cost))
        return out

    def _adjust(self, src, dst):
        self.dist = [4294967295] * self.V
        self.parent = [-1] * self.V
        self.parent_edge = [-1] * self.V
        self.in_queue = [False] * self.V
        heap = [src]
        self.dist[src] = 0
        while heap:
            v = heapq.heappop(heap) & 4294967295
            if self.in_queue[v]:
                continue
            self.in_queue[v] = True
            if v == dst:
                break
            for i in range(len(self.adj_list[v])):
                e = self.adj_list[v][i]
                if self.in_queue[e.to] or e.cap == 0:
                    continue
                rc = e.cost - self.potential[e.to] + self.potential[v]
                if self.dist[e.to] > self.dist[v] + rc:
                    self.dist[e.to] = self.dist[v] + rc
                    self.parent[e.to] = v
                    self.parent_edge[e.to] = i
                    heapq.heappush(heap, ((self.dist[e.to] << 32) + e.to))
        if not self.in_queue[dst]:
            return False
        for i in range(self.V):
            if not self.in_queue[i]:
                continue
            self.potential[i] -= self.dist[dst] - self.dist[i]
        return True

    def trade(self, src, dst, cap_limit=4294967295):
        self.potential = [0] * self.V
        self.dist = [4294967295] * self.V
        self.parent = [-1] * self.V
        self.parent_edge = [-1] * self.V
        self.in_queue = [False] * self.V
        total_flow = 0
        total_cost = 0
        prev_cost = -1
        points = [(total_flow, total_cost)]
        while total_flow < cap_limit:
            if not self._adjust(src, dst):
                break
            bottleneck = cap_limit - total_flow
            node = dst
            while node != src:
                bottleneck = min(bottleneck, self.adj_list[self.parent[node]][self.parent_edge[node]].cap)
                node = self.parent[node]
            node = dst
            while node != src:
                e = self.adj_list[self.parent[node]][self.parent_edge[node]]
                e.cap -= bottleneck
                self.adj_list[node][e.rev].cap += bottleneck
                node = self.parent[node]
            d = -self.potential[src]
            total_flow += bottleneck
            total_cost += bottleneck * d
            if prev_cost == d:
                points.pop()
            points.append((total_flow, total_cost))
            prev_cost = d
        return points

    def push(self, src, dst, cap_limit=4294967295):
        return self.trade(src, dst, cap_limit)[-1]

    class _Link:
        def __init__(self, to, rev, cap, cost):
            self.to = to
            self.rev = rev
            self.cap = cap
            self.cost = cost

import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static class NetworkFlow {
        static class Link {
            int to;
            int rev;
            long cap;
            long cost;

            Link(int to, int rev, long cap, long cost) {
                this.to = to;
                this.rev = rev;
                this.cap = cap;
                this.cost = cost;
            }
        }

        static class Connection {
            int start;
            int end;
            long capacity;
            long flow;
            long cost;

            Connection(int start, int end, long capacity, long flow, long cost) {
                this.start = start;
                this.end = end;
                this.capacity = capacity;
                this.flow = flow;
                this.cost = cost;
            }
        }

        int V;
        List<int[]> edges_descriptor;
        List<List<Link>> adj_list;
        long[] dist;
        int[] parent;
        int[] parent_edge;
        boolean[] in_queue;
        long[] potential;

        NetworkFlow(int nodes) {
            V = nodes;
            edges_descriptor = new ArrayList<>();
            adj_list = new ArrayList<>();
            for (int i = 0; i < nodes; i++) {
                adj_list.add(new ArrayList<>());
            }
        }

        int link(int u, int v, long capacity, long cost) {
            int idx = edges_descriptor.size();
            edges_descriptor.add(new int[]{u, adj_list.get(u).size()});
            adj_list.get(u).add(new Link(v, adj_list.get(v).size(), capacity, cost));
            adj_list.get(v).add(new Link(u, adj_list.get(u).size() - 1, 0, -cost));
            return idx;
        }

        Connection fetch(int i) {
            int[] descriptor = edges_descriptor.get(i);
            int u = descriptor[0];
            int pos = descriptor[1];
            Link fwd = adj_list.get(u).get(pos);
            Link bwd = adj_list.get(fwd.to).get(fwd.rev);
            return new Connection(u, fwd.to, fwd.cap + bwd.cap, bwd.cap, fwd.cost);
        }

        List<Connection> enumerate() {
            List<Connection> out = new ArrayList<>();
            for (int i = 0; i < edges_descriptor.size(); i++) {
                int[] descriptor = edges_descriptor.get(i);
                int u = descriptor[0];
                int pos = descriptor[1];
                Link fwd = adj_list.get(u).get(pos);
                Link bwd = adj_list.get(fwd.to).get(fwd.rev);
                out.add(new Connection(u, fwd.to, fwd.cap + bwd.cap, bwd.cap, fwd.cost));
            }
            return out;
        }

        boolean adjust(int src, int dst) {
            dist = new long[V];
            parent = new int[V];
            parent_edge = new int[V];
            in_queue = new boolean[V];
            for (int i = 0; i < V; i++) {
                dist[i] = Long.MAX_VALUE;
                parent[i] = -1;
                parent_edge[i] = -1;
                in_queue[i] = false;
            }
            PriorityQueue<long[]> heap = new PriorityQueue<>(Comparator.comparingLong(a -> a[0]));
            heap.offer(new long[]{0, src});
            dist[src] = 0;
            while (!heap.isEmpty()) {
                long[] cur = heap.poll();
                long d = cur[0];
                int v = (int) cur[1];
                if (in_queue[v]) continue;
                in_queue[v] = true;
                if (v == dst) break;
                for (int i = 0; i < adj_list.get(v).size(); i++) {
                    Link e = adj_list.get(v).get(i);
                    if (in_queue[e.to] || e.cap == 0) continue;
                    long rc = e.cost - potential[e.to] + potential[v];
                    if (dist[e.to] > dist[v] + rc) {
                        dist[e.to] = dist[v] + rc;
                        parent[e.to] = v;
                        parent_edge[e.to] = i;
                        heap.offer(new long[]{dist[e.to], e.to});
                    }
                }
            }
            if (!in_queue[dst]) return false;
            for (int i = 0; i < V; i++) {
                if (!in_queue[i]) continue;
                potential[i] -= dist[dst] - dist[i];
            }
            return true;
        }

        List<long[]> trade(int src, int dst, long cap_limit) {
            potential = new long[V];
            dist = new long[V];
            parent = new int[V];
            parent_edge = new int[V];
            in_queue = new boolean[V];
            long total_flow = 0;
            long total_cost = 0;
            long prev_cost = -1;
            List<long[]> points = new ArrayList<>();
            points.add(new long[]{total_flow, total_cost});
            while (total_flow < cap_limit) {
                if (!adjust(src, dst)) break;
                long bottleneck = cap_limit - total_flow;
                int node = dst;
                while (node != src) {
                    Link e = adj_list.get(parent[node]).get(parent_edge[node]);
                    bottleneck = Math.min(bottleneck, e.cap);
                    node = parent[node];
                }
                node = dst;
                while (node != src) {
                    Link e = adj_list.get(parent[node]).get(parent_edge[node]);
                    e.cap -= bottleneck;
                    adj_list.get(node).get(e.rev).cap += bottleneck;
                    node = parent[node];
                }
                long d = -potential[src];
                total_flow += bottleneck;
                total_cost += bottleneck * d;
                if (prev_cost == d) {
                    points.remove(points.size() - 1);
                }
                points.add(new long[]{total_flow, total_cost});
                prev_cost = d;
            }
            return points;
        }

        long[] push(int src, int dst, long cap_limit) {
            List<long[]> result = trade(src, dst, cap_limit);
            return result.get(result.size() - 1);
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        int n = sc.nextInt();
        long a1 = sc.nextLong();
        long a2 = sc.nextLong();
        long a3 = sc.nextLong();
        long b1 = sc.nextLong();
        long b2 = sc.nextLong();
        long b3 = sc.nextLong();

        NetworkFlow g = new NetworkFlow(8);
        g.link(0, 1, a1, 0);
        g.link(0, 2, a2, 0);
        g.link(0, 3, a3, 0);
        g.link(4, 7, b1, 0);
        g.link(5, 7, b2, 0);
        g.link(6, 7, b3, 0);
        for (int i = 1; i <= 3; i++) {
            for (int j = 4; j <= 6; j++) {
                long cost = ((j - i) % 3 == 1) ? 1 : 0;
                g.link(i, j, Long.MAX_VALUE, cost);
            }
        }

        long[] result = g.push(0, 7, Long.MAX_VALUE);
        long ans1 = result[1];
        long ans2 = Math.min(a1, b2) + Math.min(a2, b3) + Math.min(a3, b1);
        System.out.println(ans1 + " " + ans2);
    }
}
